extraction.Name: Wallace Murray
extraction.NOTES: No one is dependent upon allottee for support; allottee did not sign a receipt for the patent; never made application for the patent; was in Cuba with the Marine Corps when patent was delivered — it was delivered to his father; consideration was $4,000.00 cash at time of sale; subscribed and sworn before E. E. McKean, Superintendent, June 6, 1929
